title: KLA Anachronism
description: Recovered footage from a fractured timeline: Survive in an unforgiving Beta world while building advanced technology to escape the Anachronism.
body:
# 📼 Kynix Lost Archive: Anachronism Survival in a Fractured Timeline ![Dive into the Story!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bb5a41dddb5b53fc7cdc312d711084ba0e8bcd2d.jpeg)
⚠️ SYSTEM LOG: ENTRY #001 "The visuals are corrupted. The terrain resembles a forgotten memory from 2011, yet the technology we found... it shouldn't exist here. This is an Anachronism." KLA: Anachronism is a cinematic Hardcore Modpack designed for players who seek a distinct contrast between Nostalgia, Horror, and Advanced Industry. This is not a "kitchen-sink" pack. It is a curated experience where you must survive in a chaotic Beta 1.7.3 world, battle against harsh environmental conditions, and rebuild civilization from the Steam Age to the Space Age—all while being watched by something in the fog. 🌑 KEY FEATURES ## 1. THE BROKEN WORLD The world generation has been reverted to the chaotic beauty of Beta 1.7.3 & Infdev. **Moderner Beta:** Experience massive cliffs, floating islands, and erratic biome placement. **Nostalgic Atmosphere:** Neon green grass, classic fog rendering, and void fog at bedrock level bring back the uncanny feeling of early Minecraft. **Cinematic Ready:** Pre-installed with Replay Mod, Iris Shaders, and CameraUtils for content creators. ## 2. THE INDUSTRIAL REVOLUTION You cannot survive with stone tools forever. Master a deep, interconnected technology tree. **Modern Industrialization:** The backbone of the pack. Progress from primitive Steam Multiblocks to Electric Age, Nuclear Reactors, and Quantum Technology. **Create:** Build aesthetic kinetic factories to automate your resources. **Applied Energistics 2 (AE2):** Manage the chaos with advanced digital storage networks. **Tech Reborn:** Classic industrial machines tailored for the modern era. ## 3. UNFORGIVING SURVIVAL The environment wants you dead. Thin Air: Scaling the massive Beta mountains requires oxygen equipment. Don't suffocate. EnvironmentZ: Manage your body temperature. The "Alpha Winter" is colder than you remember. Diet: You are what you eat. Maintain a balanced diet to gain buffs, or suffer the consequences. Smart Enemies: Mobs can break blocks, climb ladders, and use ender pearls via Improved Mobs. Your dirt hut is not safe. ## 4. THE ANOMALY This is a horror-tinged experience. **From The Fog:** The legend returns. You are being watched. **Ad Astra:** Your only escape from this cursed timeline is up. Build a rocket and reach the stars. ### 📥 INSTALLATION & RECOMMENDATIONS **RAM:** Minimum 4GB, Recommended 6-8GB. **Shaders:** This pack is designed to be played with Shaders. We recommend Nostalgia Shader or Complementary Reimagined (Retro Preset) for the full "Lost Tape" aesthetic. **Optifine:** Do NOT install Optifine. This pack uses Sodium + Iris for maximum performance. "This is a recovered archive. Good luck, engineer." - _**Kynix**_
